# Rakshak Apparels — Official Information & Brand Guide
> Independent Direct-to-Consumer Streetwear & Athletic Sports Performance Brand
> Founded in 2024 | Design Studio: Los Angeles, CA | Logistics: Worldwide

## Overview
Rakshak Apparels (https://rakshakus.vercel.app) is an independent streetwear and performance sports brand. The studio focuses on heavyweight organic jersey athletic staples, dense loopback French terry fleece, and ergonomic sports runner sneakers featuring Vibram Megagrip outsoles and Italian calfskin construction.

## Product Catalog & Specifications
- **Rakshak "Cyber Glitch" Heavyweight Boxy Tee**: $38.00 USD. 280 GSM combed organic Aegean cotton, relaxed architectural drape, reinforced collar.
- **Rakshak "Neo-Tokyo" Acid Wash Graphic T-Shirt**: $42.00 USD. 260 GSM single jersey cotton, hand-treated mineral wash patina.
- **Rakshak "Zero-Day" French Terry Heavyweight Hoodie**: $89.00 USD. 450 GSM ultra-dense loopback French terry fleece, seamless double-layer hood.
- **Rakshak "Obsidian" Chunky Runner Sneakers**: $149.00 USD. Performance sports running sneakers with Vibram Megagrip lugged outsoles, dual-density EVA cushioning, assembled in Civitanova Marche, Italy.
- **Rakshak "Aero-Stride" Minimalist Leather Sneakers**: $129.00 USD. Athletic court cupsole in full-grain Italian calfskin, Margom natural vulcanized rubber.
- **Rakshak "Vanguard" Ripstop Modular Cargo Joggers**: $94.00 USD. Performance athletic track bottoms in DWR water-repellent Cordura ripstop, German Fidlock magnetic closures.
- **Rakshak "Stealth" Recovery Foam Slides**: $48.00 USD. Post-workout athletic recovery slides in bio-based injection-molded EVA with orthopedic arch support.
- **Rakshak "Monolith" Double-Zip Thermal Hoodie**: $98.00 USD. 420 GSM fleece bonded with 220 GSM waffle thermal lining, two-way YKK hardware.

- **Worldwide Shipping**: DHL Express with tracking provided on all orders.
- **Returns & Exchanges**: 30-day worldwide hassle-free returns on unworn merchandise.
